verdict.rationale: Reducto is API-first. Its docs cover endpoints for parse, extract, split, classify, edit and workflows, plus SDK calls (client.parse.run, run_job via POST /parse_async), async jobs and webhooks. A probe confirmed a live OpenAPI spec at docs.reducto.ai/openapi.json and an llms.txt index. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the API's usability.
